submitted.rationale: Out of three EQE measurements along the Ni–Sb line, index 8 (Ni0.68 Sb0.32) gave the highest value: 0.0090% at 2.1 eV illumination. That was about twice index 4 (Ni0.78) and about seven times index 19 (the NiSb2O6 trirutile composition). The measurements point to a peak somewhere in the middle of the Ni-rich range.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.0013%, the lowest of the three. This was the NiSb2O6 trirutile composition.
Measured EQE 0.0043%, lower than index 8. Adding more Ni lowered the merit.
